_comment: Sidecar metadata for the local custom SVG icons in this directory. Keyed by icon name = the SVG filename without its .svg extension (cursor-ai.svg -> 'cursor-ai' -> fa-cursor-ai in glyphs.json). Every field is optional; anything omitted falls back to a value derived from the file name. Recognised fields: 'label' (human title shown in the picker), 'terms' (extra fuzzy-search keywords), 'aliases' (alternate names), 'comment' (free-form note, carried into glyphs.json), and 'code' (hex codepoint to PIN this icon to, e.g. "10fb00", so it stays put across rebuilds and is safe to hard-code in a TUI). Without 'code' the icon is auto-assigned from CUSTOM_START (0x10fb00+) in sorted-filename order, which can shift when files are added/renamed. Pin codepoints in the custom block (>= 0x10fb00, <= 0x10fffd); avoid the relocated FA range (0x100000..0x10f8ff). Keys starting with _ or $ are ignored, so this header is safe. An 'icons' wrapper object is also accepted if you prefer.
